channel.title: SolveMyMedia — Latest Tools and Updates
channel.description: 100% Client-Side Private Audio, Video, and Image Processing Suite. Zero uploads, unlimited file size.

item.title: Compress Video
item.description: Reduce video file size without quality loss using local WebAssembly encoding.

item.title: Cut Video
item.description: Trim and cut video clips online without quality loss using local WebAssembly stream demuxing.

item.title: Compress Audio
item.description: Reduce MP3, WAV, and AAC audio file sizes while maintaining quality.

item.title: Convert Video
item.description: Convert between MP4, WebM, MKV, and MOV formats privately in your browser.

item.title: Convert Audio
item.description: Convert between audio formats (MP3, WAV, AAC, OGG) offline.

item.title: Video to Audio
item.description: Extract and save audio from any video file as MP3 or WAV.

item.title: Transcribe Audio & Video
item.description: AI-powered speech-to-text using local Whisper WASM — no API, no uploads.

item.title: Screen & Audio Recorder
item.description: Record screen, webcam, and microphone simultaneously in the browser.

item.title: Create GIF
item.description: Convert video clips to high-quality animated GIFs without uploading.

item.title: Change Video Speed
item.description: Speed up or slow down any video at custom multipliers offline.

item.title: Crop Video
item.description: Crop and resize videos for any platform without watermarks.

item.title: Mute Video
item.description: Remove the audio track from any video file instantly.

item.title: Watermark Video
item.description: Overlay text or image watermarks on video frames.

item.title: Merge Audio
item.description: Combine multiple audio files into one seamless track.
